ayapana.d: low spreading tropical American shrub with long slender leaves used to make a mildly stimulating drink resembling tea; sometimes placed in genus Eupatorium

aye-aye.d: nocturnal lemur with long bony fingers and rodent-like incisor teeth closely related to the lemurs

ayah.d: (in India) a native nursemaid who looks after children

ayrshire.d: hardy breed of dairy cattle from Ayr, Scotland

ayatollah.d: a high-ranking Shiite religious leader who is regarded as an authority on religious law and its interpretation and who has political power as well

ayurveda.d: (Sanskrit) an ancient medical treatise summarizing the Hindu art of healing and prolonging life; sometimes regarded as a 5th Veda

ayin.d: the 16th letter of the Hebrew alphabet
